content.value: Familiar Minecraft items and blocks serve different roles here. These are the changes most useful to know before planning equipment, gathering or crafting.

Use recipe lists rather than shaped patterns. Ordinary recipes appear after you obtain a valid material for every ingredient. This knowledge is personal. The [[article/cutting_bench|Cutting Bench]] makes assigned building parts; the [[article/anvil|Anvil]] makes advanced equipment, while [[article/fletching|Fletching]] and [[article/tailoring|Tailoring]] handle their specialist crafts.

The Smithing Table is the [[article/quality|Upgrade Bench]] for quality and enchantment slots. The Grindstone is the [[article/repairing|Repair Bench]] and restores durability without removing enchantments. The [[article/enchantments|Enchanting Table]] applies compatible enchantments for Lapis, and can remove or replace individual copies. The Anvil does not rename items or combine enchantments.

Breaking [[item/minecraft:ancient_debris|Ancient Debris]] without Silk Touch gives [[item/minecraft:netherite_scrap|Netherite Scrap]] directly. Silk Touch keeps the block; break it normally later for Scrap. Netherite gear is forged from Scrap at the Anvil. Use the [[article/kiln|Kiln]] for its material-processing recipes, the [[article/foundry|Foundry]] for supported metal salvage, and the [[article/smoker|Smoker]] or [[article/campfire|Campfire]] for food.

Armour uses a rating formula and protects Physical hits; Armour Toughness is not part of this defence model. Critical chance comes from your RPG statistics rather than falling attacks. Raised Shields subtract Block Value from eligible frontal hits. Hunger controls Well Fed and Starving instead of natural Health regeneration. Read [[article/defences|Defences]], [[article/damage|Damage and Criticals]] and [[article/recovery|Recovery]] when planning survival.

Potions use supported RPG effects and Lesser or regular tiers. Successful experiments at the [[article/alchemy|Alchemy Stand]] teach personal formulas. Enchantments also use Lesser and unprefixed regular names. Utility enchantments such as Silk Touch and Vein Mining remain single-copy; compatible stat enchantments may occupy several slots.

Bundles are bags that unlock storage slots, rather than containers inside an item. Hotbar, normal inventory, equipment, bags and wallet are retained on death; bag-storage contents are the section you lose when the world does not keep inventory. Hover a bag to identify its slots, and empty those slots before removing it.

Toggle supported Silk Touch and Vein Mining with the configured enchantment-toggle key. Sneaking while breaking suppresses their special harvesting behaviour for that break. Vein Mining breaks up to 31 additional connected matching ores, using suitable-tool and durability rules. Durability Preservation prevents wear; it does not repair damage already lost.
